notes.title: Chapter 3 news.
notes.notes:
what's jankin jankers! we have spent these past few months working on chapter 3 and its coming along nicely!
we will share a few things on the chapter!
- In this chapter you will play as dell. you may remember him from his 5 second appearance in the opening cutscene.
- Chapter 3 will be more focused on resource management and exploration

we cant wait to show you all the stuff we have been working on but for now have this small teaser for whats to come!
